content:
It's time to take a look at the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases. Apple's newest product officially began taking pre-orders this morning, and several major brands are ready to go. Apple has launched a series of colourful silicone cases, along with a brand-new TechWoven fabric case, and a range of perennial favourites from major third-party manufacturers. From a new burgundy version with a built-in stand, to extremely grippy customisable models, to premium leather from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods, there's something for everyone. There are also affordable options from brands like Spigen, starting from $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Featured Pick: ESR

ESR's brand-new lineup of iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories has officially arrived, featuring premium colourways, patented technology, and more. The standout is the new Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case, equipped with a built-in zinc-alloy Flex stand that seamlessly integrates with the camera bump for added protection, claiming 3x military-grade protection, and is "soft, flexible, and comfortable to the touch". The new Atelier series comes in four colourways, along with other accessories that perfectly complement the new Burgundy, Glacier, Black, and Silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case with Flex Stand: $42 (was $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector: $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock MagSafe Case: $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo MagSafe Wallet Stand with Non-Slip Grip: $46 (was $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

Nomad is one of the well-known brands for premium leather cases, and all flagship iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models are now ready. This year, the brand is also introducing a new Rugged Case series, with each colourway featuring topographic contour patterns inspired by Baja:

  • Rugged Case: $70
  • Colours: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather: $69
  • Colours: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back: $59
  • Colours: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case: $55
  • Colours: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Grey
  • Modern Leather Case: $69 to $89
  • Traditional Leather Case: $79 to $99
  • Rugged Leather Case: $79
  • Colours: Rustic Brown

Featured Pick: Dbrand

Dbrand's popular Grip Case is ready for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. In addition to having one of the cleanest designs on the market and an extremely grippy texture, this year it continues to fully support a wide range of customisable skins, so you can add a personal touch; you can also get a discount when you pair it with the matching Prism screen protector.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $55. Customisable, drop-resistant, super grippy, with excellent button feel.
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 (iPhone 18 Pro/Max), 2-pack: $35 (save $5 when purchased with a case). Easy installation, automatic alignment, completely dust-free.

Dbrand is also launching a brand-new MNML case series this year, starting from $39, offering minimalist and stylish designs at affordable prices, supporting MagSafe, while retaining the brand's signature crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case: $39. Colours: Black, Marine, Tan, Burgundy.

Spigen

  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro, Black): $14 (was $18)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro, Clear): $13 (was $17)

  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro, Blue): $19 (was $40)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro Max, Black): $19 (was $40)

Arc

The 2026 Arc Pulse aerospace-grade metal bumper case has arrived, with several new colourways added this year to match Apple's Glacier and Burgundy phones:

  • Matte Black — $69.99
  • Polished Silver — $89.99
  • Polished Graphite — $99.99
  • Matte Light Blue — $119.99
  • Matte Deep Red — $119.99
  • Polished Gold — $129.99
  • Titanium Black — $299.99

MUJJO Troubadour

  • Full Leather Case (iPhone 18 series): $59
  • Colours: Black, Basalt, Obsidian Green, Tan, Terracotta
  • Modular Case (iPhone 18 series): $59
  • The detachable magnetic back panel lets you switch between two modes. With the back panel attached: a full-grain leather case with a slim design that supports MagSafe.

Burton Goods

***Note: Enter our exclusive discount code 9TO520 at checkout for an additional 20% off the already reduced launch price on the following cases. If the code doesn't work, please use DUO10 instead.

  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $60 (was $80)
  • Luxury Pocket Book Folio Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $89 (was $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Duo): $60 (was $80)

UAG

UAG has also launched a variety of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including its signature reinforced corners, non-slip edges, and rugged models with various drop-protection designs. If you want a case that can withstand harsh environments while also being suitable for everyday protection, the UAG series is definitely worth a look.

  • UAG Mouve (iPhone Duo): $65
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case (iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max): $80
  • UAG Civilian Grip Case: from $60
  • More...

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Cases

If you want a rugged case for your new iPhone but don't want to go with common brands like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut series is definitely worth considering. These cases have passed MIL-STD-810H drop tests, offer reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotating stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a premium iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max case that won't make your phone look too bulky, Mous is a strong contender. Mous is now offering ultra-thin aramid fibre cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, as well as the following models.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case: $75
  • Mous Clear Case: $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fibre Case: $85
  • Mous Slim MagSafe Case: $55
  • Mous Slim Aramid Fibre Case: $70
  • More...

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases are known for their futuristic design, avant-garde style, and slim profile, standing out from the crowd with their unique textured finish.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-thin Aramid Fibre Case: $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case (iPhone 18 Pro): $60
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case: $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are perfect for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users who prioritise an ultra-thin design. Their products are typically made from lightweight aramid fibre, featuring a clean and understated look, while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and providing extra protection at the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Woven Case: $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop Protection Aramid Case: $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protection Case: $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also offers a diverse selection of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, ranging from slim everyday models to heavy-duty rugged designs with reliable protection. Many of the new models support MagSafe, and some even feature more grippy sides, accessory slots, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, so you can choose based on your preferred thickness and level of protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro: $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series: $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand: $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series: $60
  • More...

Belkin

Belkin is another solid choice for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, especially for users who prefer a clean style and don't want their phone to become too bulky, but don't need a fully rugged case. Their lineup typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised screen and camera edges, while some models (such as Protect+) have reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and a slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case: $30
  • Belkin Qi2-Compatible MagSafe Case with Non-Slip Grip: $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Air Cushion Corners: $60
